ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is low-intensity black. High-intensity white linear clusters are localized on the left lobe. acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks on the left lobe; significant high-contrast textural irregularity and 'fraying' at the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip displays an unusually high concentration of white pixel intensity and structural jaggedness compared to the left tip.
